events.did: counted the number of states he had crossed, the number of finished drinks in front of him and the number of empty seats to his left
events.quote_anchor: the number of states he’d crossed—six—and the number of finished drinks in front of him—two—and the number of empty seats to his left—four.

events.did: drew the inhaler from his coat pocket and turned it in the bar’s low light, studying the vivid blue contents
events.quote_anchor: Victor drew the inhaler from his coat pocket and turned it in the bar’s low light, studying the vivid blue contents

events.did: looked up, scanned the windows and saw a large black beast standing on the curb outside
events.quote_anchor: Victor looked up, scanning the windows, and saw a large black beast standing on the curb outside.

events.did: stood too fast, nearly upending what was left of his scotch, and found the dog gone when he righted the glass
events.quote_anchor: He stood too fast, nearly upending what was left of his scotch, but by the time he righted the glass, the dog was gone.

events.did: went to the restroom, bent over the sink and splashed water on his face as another man entered and threw the bolt
events.quote_anchor: He went to the restroom, was bent over the sink, splashing water on his face when he heard the sound of another man entering

events.did: recognized the man who stepped forward as June wearing his cellmate, not the real Mitchell Turner
events.quote_anchor: But then his cellmate stepped forward, and smirked, and he knew it was neither a hallucination nor the real Mitchell Turner.

events.did: hit the catch on the gun, ejecting the clip and with it a length of steel wire
events.quote_anchor: Victor hit the catch on the gun, ejecting the clip, and with it, a length of steel wire that ran between the magazine and the grip.

events.did: pinned the length of wire under his shoe and drew it tight, forcing Mitch’s wrist down against the tile
events.quote_anchor: Before she could shove back up, Victor pinned the length of wire under his shoe and drew it tight, forcing Mitch’s wrist down against the tile.

relations.did: had intercepted Victor at the gala and forced him to stop Marcella instead of going after Eli, and Victor had promised to settle the score
relations.quote_anchor: Before she intercepted him at the gala and forced him to stop Marcella instead of going after Eli.

relations.did: had waited fifteen years to kill his best friend Eli
relations.quote_anchor: He had waited fifteen years to kill his best friend.

relations.did: killed Eli and was the one who pulled the trigger
relations.quote_anchor: But Syd had been the one to pull the trigger.

relations.did: had gotten close to Sydney after Serena’s death, positioning herself as a surrogate sister
relations.quote_anchor: The shapeshifting mercenary who’d gotten close to Sydney after Serena’s death, positioned herself as a surrogate sister.

numbers.did: six — the number of states he had crossed
numbers.quote_anchor: He counted the number of states he’d crossed—six—and the number of finished drinks in front of him—two—and the number of empty seats to his left—four.

numbers.did: seven — the number of hours since his last dose
numbers.quote_anchor: He counted the number of hours since his last dose—seven—and the number until his next one—five.

numbers.did: eight — the number of other bodies in the room
numbers.quote_anchor: He lifted the glass to his mouth and counted the number of other bodies in the room—eight.

numbers.did: four and a half — the number of vials currently in his possession
numbers.quote_anchor: the number of vials currently in his possession—four and a half—and the number he’d started with—six

numbers.did: sixty-three — the number of days until he ran out of it
numbers.quote_anchor: the number of days—sixty-three—until he ran out of Haverty’s compound.

numbers.who: the showdown at the Merit gala
numbers.did: three — the number of weeks that had passed since it
numbers.quote_anchor: He counted the number of weeks—three—that had passed since the showdown at the Merit gala.
